chapter: Jack Carey's band and piano players
title: Working around town now versus before
summary: Punch says the dance halls, picnics and two-night weekend jobs are gone; Allen suggests where to go hear music.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, how did you like working around town this time as compared with before? What's the difference now?

Oh, that's a difference. I'm not saying it's a whole lot of difference. First thing, uh... I mean, it ain't like used to be the dance halls, and picnics, and Spanish food, and going way like Saturday the Bova Lucia and playing two nights. Uh-huh.
Same guys, they know you. You don't ever go out there, do you?
I have to tell you, just ask the big man to go kick off.
Yeah, well, if you were to go out there and talk to them, you know, at least one Saturday night.
Yeah, but I'd like to know, where is it at?

It's up at, around Annunciation at Sony, at Jefferson City Buzzards. That's right. You can look it up in the phone. Because they have a whole bunch of books. Well, that's the way from every year. How did Jack Carey get killed when he was carried?
